subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should this PR add `mapChannelIngressDecisionToTurnAdmission` to the experimental `plugin-sdk/channel-ingress-runtime` contract while moving WhatsApp history finalization to the shared prepared-turn path?
rationale: The change is deliberately additive but extends a public Plugin SDK subpath and changes a message-delivery-sensitive ownership boundary; repository-member authorship and the protected maintainer label require explicit human judgment.

options.title: Accept the bounded SDK export after rebase
options.body: Approve the additive mapper and shared finalization path after a rebase confirms the focused admission and history contracts remain intact.

options.title: Keep the mapper internal
options.body: Retain the WhatsApp refactor but avoid extending the Plugin SDK runtime surface until the broader channel API direction is explicitly chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded SDK export after rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the additive mapper and shared finalization path after a rebase confirms the focused admission and history contracts remain intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The author explicitly requested this person's attention on the PR, making them the best available routing candidate from the supplied evidence.
